from_speaker: based on my premium data center model
unprofitable even with a paying customer
our_interpretation: This describes the economics of projects contemplated at the time of the post, including projects not yet completed. It is not a dated forecast of future corporate earnings.
I read many as a substantial, non-isolated set of projects, without inventing a majority threshold.
Unprofitable means customer receipts fail to cover the relevant project costs, including hardware consumption or depreciation, construction, operations and financing.
The target is the March 2026 project-economics snapshot. The model's investment lifetime is unspecified and is not replaced with a one-month profit calculation.
Having a paying customer restricts the projects being assessed; it is not an antecedent of a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Independent project-level records or a reproducible model grounded in actual contracts identify a substantial set of projects whose customer payments fail to cover full costs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive, comparable project sample shows that losses under paying contracts are isolated rather than common, after including full project costs.
